U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
Form I-360, Petition for Amerasian, Widow(er), or Special Immigrant with a Classification of Special Immigrant Juvenile (C) Performance Data for Fiscal Years 2010-2012
By: Office of Performance and Quality (OPQ), Data Analysis and Reporting Branch (DARB) - NP
Data Type(s): Receipts, Approvals, Denials and Pending
1) The report reflects the most up-to-date data available at the time the report is generated.
2) The pending and completions data represents the current status of these applications. For example, the number in the "Pending" column for 2010 represents cases that went into a pending
status during that fiscal year and have not yet been adjudicated. The rejections and duplicates have been removed.
